GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to lead. led turn. weakened. Every Chance # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On arrival at the barriers, it was identified that the mare had lost its nearfore plate and required farrier attention. After attempting to replace the plate, the farrier advised that it could not be refitted. Consequently, the decision was made to remove the off-fore plate and the mare raced bare in front. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked early to settle outside leader. shared lead turn. weakened # worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the mare, rider stated that her mount was disadvantaged by being challenged in the lead and consequently weakened inside the final 150m. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked to lead. led turn going well. battled on well # worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was replated behind the barriers after losing its off fore plate.

(off-side bubble cheeker first time) slow out x 1 length . Settled Down back 7th, almost 7 Lengths @ 1000m. to 6th into Straight . Kept Finding line, dived to grab 2nd. $3 Winner Led All The Way # start no help!
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Approaching the 100m was inconvenienced by another runner which laid out under pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced 4th Two Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Six Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & chased steadily in last 200m. # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 3 lengths. 2nd turn. battled away # Every Chance
Slow Out 1/2 length worked around to settle outside leader 1 length. joined leader turn. got clear 100 metres. tired late # found enough
Jumped Ok Went Forward mad charge Settled Down 4th With Trail 3 Lengths pulling Blinkers 1st Time 3 Wide down side run ended Turn Leader bias no help but strong 2000?? weak finale # eiph
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping away. Raced keenly in the early stages. Rdr reported the filly, which was stepping up in distance and with the addition of blinkers, began well and raced keenly through the early stages and for this reason settled more forward than anticipated. A post-race vet exam revealed a degree of exercise-induced pulmonary haemorrhage which may have affected performance. Tnr was told a vet clearance is required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly . Niggled early & raced Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Held Ground until improving slowly Two Wide from 600m & behind leaders Two Wide @ 400m. Pushed along Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & challenged leaders @ 100m. No match for winner late. # Had his chance.
